name: Dependency Supply Chain Audit
description: Review manifests and lockfiles for vulnerable, suspicious, or overpowered dependencies and recommend mitigations.

operational.approval_boundary: May run local scanners and review package risk; require human approval before removing dependencies or changing production lockfiles.
operational.use_when: Use when manifests and lockfiles need vulnerability, provenance, and package risk review before trust is granted.

limitations: Instruction package only; it does not provide or authorize an executable runtime capability.
usability.quickstart: Read SKILL.md and follow the documented workflow.
